mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary conditions, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 shows a sustained increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO declines > 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases > 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
